``` {r}
# --- Set up file paths ---
bam_files <- c(
  "Nir_CTL_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_CTL_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_CTL_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam"
)

# Sample group labels
group <- factor(c("Control", "Control", "Control", "Treatment", "Treatment", "Treatment"))

# --- Create genome windows ---
# 500 bp sliding windows with 250 bp spacing
window_params <- windowCounts(bam_files, width=500, spacing=250, ext=150, BPPARAM=BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(4))
```

``` {r}

# --- Filter low-abundance windows ---
stats <- filterWindowsGlobal(window_params)
#table(keep$filter)
head(stats$filter)
keep <- stats$filter > log2(3)
#filtered <- window_params[keep$filter, ]
#filtered <- window_params[keep$filter, ]
table(keep)
filtered <- window_params[keep, ]
```

``` {r}
# --- Normalization ---
# Using TMM normalization from edgeR
y <- asDGEList(filtered)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# --- Design matrix for differential analysis ---
design <- model.matrix(~group)

# --- Estimate dispersion and fit model ---
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

# --- Differential test ---
res <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef=2)
```

```{r}
# --- Output significant results ---
results_df <- as.data.frame(topTags(res, n=Inf))
write.csv(results_df, "csaw_differential_results.csv", row.names=FALSE)

# Optional: export as BED
sig_windows <- results_df[results_df$FDR < 0.05, ]
sig_regions <- rowRanges(filtered)[rownames(filtered) %in% rownames(sig_windows)]
head(sig_windows)
write.csv(sig_windows, "csaw_sigDiff_results.csv", row.names=FALSE)
rtracklayer::export(sig_regions, "csaw_significant_regions.bed", format="BED")
```

``` {r}
#

# adapted from https:6

# load dependencies
library(ChIPseeker)
library(csaw)
library(edgeR)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggplot2)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

```

``` {r}
# read peaks files and convert to GRanges
# CTL Peaks
AUT.peaks <- read.table("Nir_CTL_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BUT.peaks <- read.table("Nir_CTL_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
CUT.peaks <- read.table("Nir_CTL_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
colnames(AUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(CUT.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
AUT.peaks <- GRanges(AUT.peaks)
BUT.peaks <- GRanges(BUT.peaks)
CUT.peaks <- GRanges(CUT.peaks)
UT.peaks <- intersect(intersect(AUT.peaks, BUT.peaks), CUT.peaks)

AINTS11.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int11aux_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BINTS11.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int11aux_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
CINTS11.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int11aux_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
colnames(AINTS11.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BINTS11.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(CINTS11.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
AINTS11.peaks <- GRanges(AINTS11.peaks)
BINTS11.peaks <- GRanges(BINTS11.peaks)
CINTS11.peaks <- GRanges(CINTS11.peaks)
MINTS11.peaks <- intersect(intersect(AINTS11.peaks, BINTS11.peaks), CINTS11.peaks)

AINTS1.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int1aux_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
BINTS1.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int1aux_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
CINTS1.peaks <- read.table("Nir_Int1aux_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.tn5.pval0.01.300K.bfilt.narrowPeak.gz", sep="\t")[,1:3]
colnames(AINTS1.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(BINTS1.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
colnames(CINTS1.peaks) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
AINTS1.peaks <- GRanges(AINTS1.peaks)
BINTS1.peaks <- GRanges(BINTS1.peaks)
CINTS1.peaks <- GRanges(CINTS1.peaks)
MINTS1.peaks <- intersect(intersect(AINTS1.peaks, BINTS1.peaks), CINTS1.peaks)

all.peaks <- union(union(UT.peaks, MINTS1.peaks), MINTS11.peaks)
print("Completed")
```

``` {r}
# prep blacklist and chromosome restriction
blacklist <- read.table("hg38-blacklist.v2.bed", sep="\t")
colnames(blacklist) <- c("chrom", "start", "end")
blacklist <- GRanges(blacklist)
standard.chr <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))
param <- readParam(max.frag=1000, pe="both", discard=blacklist, restrict=standard.chr)
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# load and count reads from bam files
pe.bams <- c(
  "Nir_CTL_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_CTL_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_CTL_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int11aux_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int11aux_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int11aux_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep1_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep2_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam",
  "Nir_Int1aux_rep3_ATAC_CKDL240033405-1A_22V7K3LT3_L4_1.trim.srt.nodup.no_chrM_MT.bam"
)
peak.counts <- regionCounts(pe.bams, all.peaks, param=param)
peak.abundances <- aveLogCPM(asDGEList(peak.counts))
peak.counts.filt <- peak.counts[peak.abundances > -3, ]


# generate window counts (NOTE: MAYBE CHANGE CONSTANT VALUES?)
counts <- windowCounts(pe.bams, width=300, param=param)
neighbor <- suppressWarnings(resize(rowRanges(counts), width=2000, fix="center"))
wider <- regionCounts(pe.bams, regions=neighbor, param=param)
filter.stat <- filterWindowsLocal(counts, wider)
counts.local.filt <- counts[filter.stat$filter > log2(3),]
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# MACS TMM normalization
binned <- windowCounts(pe.bams, bin=TRUE, width=10000, param=param)
working.windows <- peak.counts.filt
working.windows <- normFactors(binned, se.out=working.windows)
```

```{r}
# setup design matrix
y <- asDGEList(working.windows)
colnames(y$counts) <- c(
  "AUT", "BUT", "CUT",
  "AINTS11", "BINTS11", "CINTS11",
  "AINTS1", "BINTS1", "CINTS1"
)
rownames(y$samples) <- c(
  "AUT", "BUT", "CUT",
  "AINTS11", "BINTS11", "CINTS11",
  "AINTS1", "BINTS1", "CINTS1"
)
y$samples$group <- c(
  "UT", "UT", "UT",
  "MINTS11", "MINTS11", "MINTS11",
  "MINTS1", "MINTS1", "MINTS1"
)
design <- model.matrix(~0+group, data=y$samples)
print(design)
colnames(design) <- c("UT", "MINTS11", "MINTS1")
print("Completed")
```

```{r}
# differential accessibility testing
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmFit(y, design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = 2)
csaw_deg_table <- as.data.frame(topTags(lrt, n = nrow(y), sort.by = 'PValue'))
csaw_deg_table <- csaw_deg_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(csaw_deg_table),
                type = ifelse(FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1.0, 'significant', 'not significant')) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, type)
fig_ma <- csaw_deg_table %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logCPM, y = logFC, color = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#666666', '#d62728'))
print(fig_ma)
```

```{r}

qlf <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust=TRUE)
# # MINTS11 v MINTS1
qlft <- glmQLFTest(qlf, contrast=makeContrasts(MINTS1-MINTS11, levels=design))


rowData(working.windows) <- cbind(rowData(working.windows), qlft$table)
merged.peaks <- mergeWindows(rowRanges(working.windows), tol=500L, max.width=5000L)
tab.best <- getBestTest(merged.peaks$id, qlft$table)
final.merged.peaks <- merged.peaks$region
final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata <- cbind(final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata, tab.best[, -1])
final.merged.peaks <- final.merged.peaks[order(final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata$FDR), ]
final.merged.peaks.sig <- final.merged.peaks[final.merged.peaks@elementMetadata$FDR < 0.05, ]


# generate plot
final.merged.peaks$sig <- "n.s"
final.merged.peaks$sig[final.merged.peaks$FDR < 0.05] <- "significant"
# ...
test_df <- as.data.frame(final.merged.peaks)[sample(nrow(as.data.frame(final.merged.peaks)), 15000), ]
test_df$sig <- "n.s"
test_df$sig[test_df$FDR < 0.05] <- "significant"
# ...
ggplot(data=data.frame(test_df),
       aes(x = rep.test, y = rep.logFC, col = sig)) +
    geom_point() + scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
    geom_smooth(inherit.aes = F, aes(x = rep.test, y = rep.logFC), method = "loess") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + labs(col = NULL)
```

Differential Comparison to CTL
```{r}
# Refit QL model with design
qlf <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust=TRUE)

# CTL vs MINTS1
qlft_mints1 <- glmQLFTest(qlf, contrast=makeContrasts(UT - MINTS1, levels=design))

# CTL vs MINTS11
qlft_mints11 <- glmQLFTest(qlf, contrast=makeContrasts(UT - MINTS11, levels=design))

# MINTS1 vs MINTS11
qlft_m1vm11 <- glmQLFTest(qlf, contrast=makeContrasts(MINTS1 - MINTS11, levels=design))

```


Merge differential windows and get peaks
```{r}
# Shared merged windows for consistency
merged.peaks <- mergeWindows(rowRanges(working.windows), tol=500L, max.width=5000L)

# Get best window in each merged region
tab_mints1 <- getBestTest(merged.peaks$id, qlft_mints1$table)
tab_mints11 <- getBestTest(merged.peaks$id, qlft_mints11$table)
tab_m1vm11 <- getBestTest(merged.peaks$id, qlft_m1vm11$table)

# Attach metadata
final.merged.peaks_mints1 <- merged.peaks$region
final.merged.peaks_mints1@elementMetadata <- cbind(final.merged.peaks_mints1@elementMetadata, tab_mints1[, -1])
final.merged.peaks_mints1 <- final.merged.peaks_mints1[order(final.merged.peaks_mints1$FDR), ]

final.merged.peaks_mints11 <- merged.peaks$region

final.merged.peaks_m1vm11 <- merged.peaks$region
```

``` {r}
############
# Begin Volcano Plots
############

# GRanges -> dataframe and annotate

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

prepare_volcano_df <- function(gr, comparison_name) {
  df <- as.data.frame(gr)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(gene_type = case_when(
      rep.logFC >= 1 & FDR <= 0.05 ~ "up",
      rep.logFC <= -1 & FDR <= 0.05 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FoldChange = rep.logFC,
      padj = FDR,
      Comparison = comparison_name
    )
  return(df)
}

# Create data frames
df_mints1_vs_ctl <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_mints1, "MINTS1 vs CTL")
df_mints11_vs_ctl <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_mints11, "MINTS11 vs CTL")
df_mints1_vs_mints11 <- prepare_volcano_df(final.merged.peaks_m1vm11, "MINTS1 vs MINTS11")



```

``` {r}

##################
# Volcano plot function
##################

make_volcano_plot <- function(df, title, outfile) {
  cols <- c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "ns" = "grey")
  sizes <- c("up" = 2, "down" = 2, "ns" = 1)
  alphas <- c("up" = 1, "down" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = gene_type, size = gene_type, alpha = gene_type),
               shape = 21, colour = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_size_manual(values = sizes) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50), xlim = c(-5, 5)) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "log2(fold change)",
         y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16, family = "Arial", face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )

  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p, width = 12, height = 9)
  return(p)
}

```

``` {r}
################
# Distance to TSS of peaks

library(GenomicRanges)
library(dplyr)

# Read gene BED file (assume 6 columns: chr, start, end, name, ., strand)
genes_df <- read.table("all_genes.bed", sep="\t", header=FALSE,
                       col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "placeholder", "strand"))

# Determine TSS based on strand
genes_df <- genes_df %>%
  mutate(TSS = ifelse(strand == "+", start, end))  # + uses start, - uses end

# Convert to GRanges
genes_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = genes_df$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = genes_df$TSS, end = genes_df$TSS),  # TSS as point
  strand = genes_df$strand,
  gene = genes_df$name
)
```

```{r Euler}
library(eulerr)

# Read file (assuming tab-separated, quote-safe)
df <- read.table("union.tsv", sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract annotations from columns 5 and 9
annot1 <- gsub("\\s*\\(.*?\\)", "", df[, 5])  # Clean anchor 1 annotations
annot2 <- gsub("\\s*\\(.*?\\)", "", df[, 9])  # Clean anchor 2 annotations

# Create counts for all combinations
combo_counts <- as.data.frame(table(annot1, annot2))

# Remove zero-count combinations
combo_counts <- subset(combo_counts, Freq > 0)

# Initialize empty named vector
euler_input <- c()

for (i in 1:nrow(combo_counts)) {
  a1 <- combo_counts$annot1[i]
  a2 <- combo_counts$annot2[i]
  freq <- combo_counts$Freq[i]
  
  if (a1 == a2) {
    # Single-annotation set
    if (!paste0(a1) %in% names(euler_input)) {
      euler_input[paste0(a1)] <- 0
    }
    euler_input[paste0(a1)] <- euler_input[paste0(a1)] + freq
  } else {
    # Overlap between two annotations
    overlap_name <- paste(sort(c(a1, a2)), collapse = "&")  # Sorted ensures A&B == B&A
    if (!overlap_name %in% names(euler_input)) {
      euler_input[overlap_name] <- 0
    }
    euler_input[overlap_name] <- euler_input[overlap_name] + freq
  }
}

# Handle NA-initialized values
euler_input[is.na(euler_input)] <- 0

# Plot Euler diagram
fit <- euler(euler_input)
p <- plot(fit,
     quantities = TRUE,
     #fills = list(fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.5),
     labels = list(font = 2),
     legend = list(title = "Annotation Type"))

ggsave("annotationUnion_pie_chart.png", plot = p, width = 15, height = 12, dpi = 300)

```

```{r Upset-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(ComplexUpset)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# Load union file
df <- read_tsv("Ints1_v_Ctl_up1.tsv", col_names = FALSE)

# Columns:
# V1: ID
# V5: annotation from file1
# V9: annotation from file2

# Clean annotations (remove anything in parentheses)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(annotation1 = str_replace_all(X9, "\\s*\\(.*?\\)", ""),
         annotation2 = str_replace_all(X16, "\\s*\\(.*?\\)", ""))

# Get unique annotations across both columns
all_annots <- unique(c(df$annotation1, df$annotation2))

# Create binary columns for each annotation
for (annot in all_annots) {
  df[[annot]] <- as.integer(df$annotation1 == annot | df$annotation2 == annot)
}

# Keep ID + annotation binary columns
upset_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(ID = X1, dplyr::all_of(all_annots))

# Plot UpSet with ComplexUpset
p <- upset(
  upset_df,
  intersect = all_annots,
  name = "Anchor Pair Annotation Intersections",
  base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(
      text = list(vjust = -0.5),
      bar_width = 0.8
    )
    + ylim(c(0, 1350))
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.1
)

ggsave("Ints1_v_Ctl_up1_upset_chart.png", plot = p, width = 15, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

``` {r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggrepel)

# Load bindetect results
bindetect1 <- read_tsv("bindetect_results.txt", col_names = FALSE, skip = 1)
bindetect2 <- read_tsv("bindetect_results.txt", col_names = FALSE, skip = 1)

# Rename relevant columns
colnames(bindetect1)[c(2, 10, 11)] <- c("TF", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
colnames(bindetect2)[c(2, 10, 11)] <- c("TF", "log2FoldChange", "padj")

# Add gene_type column based on thresholds
prepare_volcano_data <- function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)  # convert to base data.frame
  df %>%
    mutate(
      padj = as.numeric(padj),
      log2FoldChange = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
      gene_type = case_when(
        padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0.4 ~ "up",
        padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -0.4 ~ "down",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      log_padj = -log10(padj)
    )
}

df1 <- prepare_volcano_data(bindetect1)
df2 <- prepare_volcano_data(bindetect2)

df1
df2

```

```{r}

make_volcano_plot <- function(df, title, outfile, label_tfs = NULL) {
  cols <- c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "ns" = "grey")
  sizes <- c("up" = 2, "down" = 2, "ns" = 1)
  alphas <- c("up" = 1, "down" = 1, "ns" = 0.5)

  # Optional: extract just the TFs you want to label
  label_df <- df %>% filter(TF %in% label_tfs)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = gene_type, size = gene_type, alpha = gene_type),
               shape = 21, colour = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.4, 0.4), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_size_manual(values = sizes) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = TF),
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    size = 4,
                    fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 250), xlim = c(-0.75, 0.75)) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "log2(fold change)",
         y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )

  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p, width = 12, height = 9)
  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
### -----------------------------
atac_peaks_file <- "overlap.optimal_peak.narrowPeak.gz"         # gzipped ATAC peaks file
fithic_file <- "Ints1_v_Ctl_leftAnchATACOverlap_ONLY.tsv"   # Fithic left-anchor overlap file
output_overlap <- "Ints1_v_Ctl_leftAnchDiffATAC_rightNonDiff.tsv"
output_no_overlap <- "Ints1_v_Ctl_leftAnchDiffATAC_NORIGHT.tsv"
bin_size <- 2000  # Bin size for Fithic anchors

### -----------------------------
### STEP 1: READ ATAC PEAKS (with annotation)
### -----------------------------
atac_peaks <- readr::read_tsv(atac_peaks_file, col_names = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%  # Keep first 4 columns (chrom, start, end, peak_name)
  dplyr::rename(chrom = X1, start = X2, end = X3, peak_name = X4)

# Convert to GRanges with annotation
atac_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = atac_peaks$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = atac_peaks$start, end = atac_peaks$end),
  peak_name = atac_peaks$peak_name
)

### -----------------------------
### STEP 2: READ FITHIC ANCHOR OVERLAP FILE
### -----------------------------
fithic_df <- readr::read_tsv(fithic_file, col_names = FALSE)
# ADJUSTED FOR THE FC COLUMN
colnames(fithic_df) <- c("combined", "chr1", "start1", "end1", "l2fc", "chr2", "start2", "end2", "annotation")

### -----------------------------
### STEP 3: EXTRACT TRUE RIGHT ANCHOR FROM `combined`
### -----------------------------
split_vals <- strsplit(fithic_df$combined, "_")

# Extract chromosome, left anchor start, right anchor start
chrom_val <- sapply(split_vals, `[`, 1)
right_val <- as.numeric(sapply(split_vals, `[`, 3))     # Grabbing the right anchor

# Add correct right anchor info
fithic_df <- fithic_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    chrom_right = paste0("chr", chrom_val),
    right_anchor_start = right_val,
    right_anchor_end = right_val + bin_size
  )

### -----------------------------
### STEP 4: CONVERT RIGHT ANCHOR TO GRanges
### -----------------------------
right_anchor_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = fithic_df$chrom_right,
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = fithic_df$right_anchor_start,
                            end = fithic_df$right_anchor_end)
)

### -----------------------------
### STEP 5: FIND OVERLAPS AND ADD ANNOTATION
### -----------------------------
hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(right_anchor_gr, atac_gr)

# Combine overlaps into data frame
overlap_df <- fithic_df[S4Vectors::queryHits(hits), ] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    overlap_peak_coord = paste0(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)], ":",
                                IRanges::start(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)], "-",
                                IRanges::end(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)]),
    overlap_peak_name = mcols(atac_gr)$peak_name[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
    overlap_annotation = "ATAC_peak_overlap"
  )

# Convert overlapping ATAC peaks into GRanges
overlap_atac_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = IRanges::start(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
                            end = IRanges::end(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)])
)

# Annotate with genomic feature using ChIPseeker
annot_res <- ChIPseeker::annotatePeak(overlap_atac_gr, TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

# Convert annotation to data frame
annot_df <- as.data.frame(annot_res)

# Extract annotation info
annotation_labels <- annot_df$annotation

# Add annotation to overlap_df
overlap_df$genomic_annotation <- annotation_labels

# Anchors without overlaps
no_overlap_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(fithic_df)), S4Vectors::queryHits(hits))
no_overlap_df <- fithic_df[no_overlap_idx, ]

### -----------------------------
### STEP 6: SAVE OUTPUT
### -----------------------------
readr::write_tsv(overlap_df, output_overlap)
readr::write_tsv(no_overlap_df, output_no_overlap)

cat("✅ Overlap analysis complete!\n")
cat("Anchors with overlap: ", nrow(overlap_df), "\n")
cat("Anchors without overlap: ", nrow(no_overlap_df), "\n")
cat("Results saved to:\n", output_overlap, "\n", output_no_overlap, "\n")

```

```{r}
######################
# Single anchor overlap on the right anchor, to add the left anchor
######################

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ChIPseeker)

### -----------------------------

output_overlap <- "Ints1_v_Ctl_rightAnchDiffATAC_leftNonDiff.tsv"
output_no_overlap <- "Ints1_v_Ctl_rightAnchDiffATAC_NOLEFT.tsv"
bin_size <- 2000  # Bin size for Fithic anchors

### -----------------------------
### STEP 1: READ ATAC PEAKS (with annotation)
### -----------------------------
atac_peaks <- readr::read_tsv(atac_peaks_file, col_names = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%  # Keep first 4 columns (chrom, start, end, peak_name)
  dplyr::rename(chrom = X1, start = X2, end = X3, peak_name = X4)

# Convert to GRanges with annotation
atac_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = atac_peaks$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = atac_peaks$start, end = atac_peaks$end),
  peak_name = atac_peaks$peak_name
)

### -----------------------------
### STEP 2: READ FITHIC ANCHOR OVERLAP FILE
### -----------------------------
fithic_df <- readr::read_tsv(fithic_file, col_names = FALSE)
#  ADJUSTED FOR FC COLUMN
colnames(fithic_df) <- c("combined", "chr1", "start1", "end1", "l2fc", "chr2", "start2", "end2", "annotation")

### -----------------------------
### STEP 3: EXTRACT TRUE LEFT ANCHOR FROM `combined`
### -----------------------------
split_vals <- strsplit(fithic_df$combined, "_")

# Extract chromosome, left anchor start, right anchor start
chrom_val <- sapply(split_vals, `[`, 1)
right_val <- as.numeric(sapply(split_vals, `[`, 2))    # Grabbing the left anchor

# Add correct right anchor info
fithic_df <- fithic_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    chrom_right = paste0("chr", chrom_val),
    right_anchor_start = right_val,
    right_anchor_end = right_val + bin_size
  )

### -----------------------------
### STEP 4: CONVERT RIGHT ANCHOR TO GRanges
### -----------------------------
right_anchor_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = fithic_df$chrom_right,
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = fithic_df$right_anchor_start,
                            end = fithic_df$right_anchor_end)
)

### -----------------------------
### STEP 5: FIND OVERLAPS AND ADD ANNOTATION
### -----------------------------
hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(right_anchor_gr, atac_gr)

# Combine overlaps into data frame
overlap_df <- fithic_df[S4Vectors::queryHits(hits), ] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    overlap_peak_coord = paste0(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)], ":",
                                IRanges::start(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)], "-",
                                IRanges::end(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)]),
    overlap_peak_name = mcols(atac_gr)$peak_name[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
    overlap_annotation = "ATAC_peak_overlap"
  )

# Convert overlapping ATAC peaks into GRanges
overlap_atac_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  seqnames = GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
  ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = IRanges::start(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)],
                            end = IRanges::end(atac_gr)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)])
)

# Annotate with genomic feature using ChIPseeker
annot_res <- ChIPseeker::annotatePeak(overlap_atac_gr, TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

# Convert annotation to data frame
annot_df <- as.data.frame(annot_res)

# Extract annotation info
annotation_labels <- annot_df$annotation

# Add annotation to overlap_df
overlap_df$genomic_annotation <- annotation_labels

# Anchors without overlaps
no_overlap_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(fithic_df)), S4Vectors::queryHits(hits))
no_overlap_df <- fithic_df[no_overlap_idx, ]

### -----------------------------
```
